appraisal_events.evidence: Mais, monsieur Swann, vous ne partirez pas sans avoir touché les petits bronzes des dossiers... je vous promets un bon moment.
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Verdurin singles Swann out with sustained personal address and hospitality, inviting him into the prized intimacy of her salon's collection ahead of the other guests.

status_effects.explanation: Swann is the object of the hostess's concentrated hospitable attention, marking his warm reception into the salon's inner circle.

ambiguities: M. Verdurin is briefly addressed by his wife ('sois poli au moins, ne dis pas que tu ne l'as jamais été...') as she recounts his supposed past jealousy of her; the passage cuts off before it is clear whether this is affectionate banter or a mild public correction, so no event was scored for him.
